2164. Leap Year Checker

60

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a year and print True if it is a leap year, otherwise print False.
Description
Read a year and check whether it is a leap year. Print True if it is a leap year, otherwise print False. A year is a leap year if it is divisible by 4 but not divisible by 100, or if it is divisible by 400. For example, 2024 and 2000 are leap years, but 1900 and 2023 are not.
input_spec: A single integer, the year. (1 <= year <= 9999)
output_spec: Print True if the year is a leap year, otherwise print False.
